title: 133. EATING DISORDERS: Signs, Symptoms, Social Media, & Support Systems feat. Dr. Sam DeCaro
description_html: Today's guest is Dr. Sam DeCaro— a licensed psychologist who provides individual, family, and couples therapy. Dr. DeCaro also served as an Assistant Clinical Director at the Renfrew Center for Eating Disorders and currently shares her eating disorder expertise as a writer and speaker. In this episode, we discuss common risk factors for eating disorders, signs that someone may be developing an eating disorder, ways that parents and loved ones can support someone with an eating disorder, how social media can affect body image and contribute to eating disorders, common eating disorder myths, and eating disorder resources that people can turn to for help.

summary: sadie talks with dr. sam decaro, a licensed psychologist and clinical director at the renfrew center for eating disorders. they cover what causes eating disorders (genetics, biology, trauma, transitions, even dieting), signs that disordered eating is becoming dangerous (obsessive thoughts, guilt around food, exercise compulsion, social withdrawal), and how social media affects body image. dr. decaro explains how families can support recovery—validating emotions, examining their own relationships with food and body image, and learning skills together. she also debunks myths about treatment (it's collaborative, not about forcing anyone to eat) and shares resources like neda's parent toolkit and renfrew's free webinars.
